name: alasima-mobile
description: متجر العاصمة for Android and iPhone (Capacitor wrapper around the web app)

scripts.android: npm run web && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && npx @capacitor/assets generate --android
scripts.ios: npm run web && npx cap add ios && npx cap sync ios && npx @capacitor/assets generate --ios
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
